name: A fund loss larger than the year's capital income is carried forward in the general pot
workings: The salary is taxed as in employee-75k: 13,935.657745
Equity ETF: loss 10,000.00, 70% after the partial exemption = 7,000.00; interest 500.00
General pot: 500.00 − 7,000.00 = −6,500.00: no capital income to tax (the allowance goes unused), and 6,500.00 is carried forward without limit (§20 Abs. 6 Satz 3)
